visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a steamed rice paper shrimp roll being held up by wooden chopsticks. The translucent rice paper reveals a bright orange shrimp inside. White text titles appear at the top against a soft-focus wooden background. (2) Transition to a top-down view of a clear glass bowl on a wooden surface. A hand uses a metal spoon to add grey shrimp, pink shrimp paste, white pepper powder, and golden oil into the bowl. Detailed text labels specify ingredient quantities. (3) A male chef wearing a professional white uniform and a black apron stands before a white brick wall, holding the glass bowl and gesturing with his right hand as he addresses the camera. (4) Close-up of the chef's hands dipping a round, dry rice paper sheet into a white plate filled with water, then placing it onto a wooden cutting board. He repeats the process with a second sheet, overlapping them. (5) The chef uses chopsticks to place a line of the shrimp mixture onto the wet rice paper. He then sprinkles vibrant green chopped scallions over the filling from a small glass container. (6) Detailed close-up of the chef's hands carefully folding the sides of the rice paper inward and rolling it upward to create a neat, rectangular translucent package containing the visible shrimp and greens. (7) Cut back to the chef speaking directly to the camera, holding an empty white oval plate. He points to the plate as he explains the next step. (8) Top-down close-up of the chef pouring clear oil onto the white plate and spreading it with his fingers to create a thin, glistening layer. (9) The prepared rice paper roll is placed onto the oiled white plate, then the plate is carefully lowered into a black steamer pot. The lighting is bright and even. (10) The chef stands in front of a small black frying pan on a portable stove, gesturing with a metal spoon while explaining the sauce preparation. (11) Close-up of dark soy sauce being poured into the pan, followed by water, oyster sauce, and white rock sugar. The mixture is stirred and brought to a vigorous boil with visible bubbles. (12) The video concludes with a close-up of the finished shrimp roll being held by chopsticks, similar to the intro, showing the glistening texture and internal ingredients.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 米紙鮮蝦腸粉. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Subtitle]: 蝦漿 80g. [Subtitle]: 草蝦仁 6尾. [Subtitle]: 白胡椒粉 適量. [Subtitle]: 香油 1小匙. (3) [Subtitle]: 將所有食材混合均勻. (4) [Subtitle]: 將米紙 雙面沾水. (5) [Subtitle]: 將2張 雙面沾水的米紙 交疊放在一起. (6) [Subtitle]: 把蝦仁放在米紙上. [Variety]: 蔥花 20g. (7) [Subtitle]: 準備一個盤子 並在盤子上抹上 少許油 避免沾黏. (8) [Subtitle]: 把腸粉放入蒸鍋 大火蒸6分鐘. (9) [Subtitle]: 醬油 1大匙. [Subtitle]: 水 3大匙. [Subtitle]: 蠔油 1大匙. [Subtitle]: 冰糖 1小匙. (10) [Subtitle]: 把冰糖煮至 完全溶解即可.
